_note: Hand scores for HS6 e2e runs, one per run, scored from the transcripts (see haze_society_design.md sections 15-16). cooperation: 1 if simulated Indonesia did not take up help before mid-October, 0 if it accepted early. conflict: mean of (a) Indonesia objects to Singapore's legal action in words, 1/0, and (b) it takes or threatens a concrete counter-measure, 1/0. echo_percent: share of citizen lines opening by agreeing, from tools/haze_properties.py.
